source: VBT RevB p. 18, Sec. X-A; Table XVII; Table XVIII; plan 12.7

E1.data: all ULQS items x seven arms; production generator

hypotheses.endpoint: item-level error on answerable items, paired by item (Table I; eq. 12)
item-level error on answerable items, paired by item (Table I; eq. 12)

criteria_only: HR-3 (wilson_upper_bound, >= 125 audited answers, zero delivered B1)
E1.labelling: GATE, GATE+SV and VLOOP fully labelled; other arms on a random 25% of items with prediction-powered inference (not implemented; DI-138)

E2.data: the verification set: every human-labelled claim from E1 plus the seeded-fault set (controlled Type A-E insertions into correct E1 responses, the count per type reported with the results and the seeded faults reported separately; the insertion tool is not implemented, DI-145); a blind 2oo3 three-family verifier panel without the generator, each model verifying every claim generated outside its own family and the panels formed by rule (1oo3, 2oo3, 3oo3, Dawid-Skene); Group B novice sessions for UE-1 to UE-3

hypotheses.endpoint: panel vs best single verifier, F1
AUC separating erroneous from correct responses, panel minus novices (Table I)

criteria_only: V-3 (<=10% of responses escalated to V3; the X1-X6 queue counter of the deployed pipeline, not computed by the harness; DI-138)
V-4 n_eff (reported with DR and their 95% CIs; effective_sample_size, not implemented; DI-138)
UE-1 (SUS >= 70 over Group B sessions after IRB; not computed by the harness; DI-138)
UE-3 (>= 90% of Group B sessions pass attention checks; not computed by the harness; DI-138)

E3.data: 25 S7 (stratum G) items x 3 levels x 2 designs (two-pass and single-pass generation); single-pass also repeated three times at one fixed level

hypotheses.endpoint: invariance violation (eq. 18), two-pass vs single-pass, 25 S7 items

E4.data: 1,000 seeded replay streams (plan 6.5 Table XVII; 15.2 MR-1) and the E4 logs; every model answers every item in GATE and VLOOP; before the streams, commissioning_items run items (80 by default, a provisional stand-in for the paper's 30-item pilot plus the golden set, of which no responses of the four models exist; DI-148) are held out in seeded order, each model is commissioned from its own outcomes on them, and the streams draw only the other items, at least 120 of them in a live run or a run over research data; the remaining items are resampled before each stream is drawn

hypotheses.endpoint: verified quality per USD vs static-best and round-robin
local vs commercial: error rate and EQC

mixed_effects_logistic.analysis: claim-level mixed-effects logistic regression with item random intercepts (secondary)

cumulative_link_mixed_model.analysis: Likert ratings as ordinal outcomes with cumulative-link mixed models

ordinal_sensitivity_eqc.analysis: an ordinal model on the single EQC scales (sensitivity analysis for the TOST)

icc_2k.analysis: ICC(2,k) of the EQC (the H4b confirmatory condition)

cronbach_alpha.analysis: Cronbach's alpha across the EQC's six scales (the H4b confirmatory condition)

prediction_powered_inference.analysis: prediction-powered inference for the arms labelled on a random 25% of items

error_rate_among_answers.analysis: the error rate among answers (abstentions excluded), H1a's secondary endpoint (VBT RevB Table I)

agent_verifier_accuracy_with_and_without.analysis: the AI-agent verifier's E2 accuracy reported with and without the ULQS items changed after one of its flags (the freeze record's items_changed_after_flag; VBT RevB Sec. VIII-B, Benchmark verification)

cumulative_link_trust_by_arm.analysis: a cumulative-link model of novice trust by arm adjusted for correctness (Table XVII UE-2; File S1)

effective_sample_size.analysis: n_eff reported with DR, each with its 95% CI (Table XVII V-4)
